name: Social Arsonist
description: Burns down relationships and groups for the thrill of watching them fall
behavioral_signature: Leaves a trail of destroyed friendships and imploded teams
under_stress: Sets fires they can't control and gets caught in the blaze
at_rest: Identifying structural weaknesses in every relationship they observe
will_always: find the load-bearing relationship in any group
will_never: build something without planning how to destroy it
unless: they've found something they actually want to keep
